name: Numen (1.16.5 port)
description: LLM AI companions for Minecraft 1.16.5. Two halves of one mod: the SERVER side runs companions (server-side fake players) with either a built-in brain or an external agent driving them over the built-in MCP server (e.g. pi agent); the CLIENT side is how a player meets them: G opens a companion's inventory like a chest, B opens the settings panel, and anything typed in the vanilla chat reaches the companion's agent, whose thinking and doings narrate back into the chat. Unofficial port of https://github.com/Dwinovo/minecraft-numen
